# Domain Modeling

Actively build and sharpen the project's domain model as you design. This is the *active* discipline — challenging terms, inventing edge-case scenarios, and writing the glossary and decisions down the moment they crystallise. ## File structure

Most repos have a single context:

```
/
├── CONTEXT.md
├── docs/
│   └── adr/
│       ├── 0001-event-sourced-orders.md
│       └── 0002-postgres-for-write-model.md
└── src/
```

If a `CONTEXT-MAP.md` exists at the root, the repo has multiple contexts. The map points to where each one lives:

```
/
├── CONTEXT-MAP.md
├── docs/
│   └── adr/                          ← system-wide decisions
├── src/
│   ├── ordering/
│   │   ├── CONTEXT.md
│   │   └── docs/adr/                 ← context-specific decisions
│   └── billing/
```

+# Specification: Corriger assertSuccess dans acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts
+
+## Problem Statement
+
+La fonction `assertSuccess` dans `acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts` ne formate pas correctement les messages d'erreur lorsqu'un processus échoue. Actuellement, elle utilise un format simple qui ne distingue pas clairement les flux stderr et stdout, ce qui rend le débogage plus difficile.
+
+## Solution
+
+Modifier la fonction `assertSuccess` pour inclure les messages stderr et stdout de manière structurée et lisible, avec le format suivant :
+- `[stderr] <message_trimé_non_vide>\n[stdout] <message_trimé_non_vide>` uniquement si les flux sont non vides
+- stderr avant stdout
+- Si les deux flux sont vides : conserver le comportement existant `Unable to <action>: exit code N`
+- Préserver le comportement succès inchangé
+
+## User Stories
+
+1. As a developer, I want to see stderr and stdout messages clearly separated in error messages, so that I can quickly identify which stream contains the relevant error information
+2. As a developer, I want stderr to appear before stdout in error messages, so that I see the most critical information first
+3. As a developer, I want empty streams to be omitted from error messages, so that I only see relevant information
+4. As a developer, I want the existing fallback behavior preserved when both streams are empty, so that I still get meaningful error information
+5. As a developer, I want success cases to remain unchanged, so that existing functionality is not broken
+
+## Implementation Decisions
+
